title: Monthly Tier Review of Pocketwire Business Profiles
content:
Pocketwire Business Profile tiers are reviewed on the first day of each calendar month against the previous month's net sales volume: the sales less the refunds and chargebacks on the profile dated in the calendar month before the month of the review.

**Moving up.** The profile moves up to the highest tier whose entry volume that net sales volume meets. Pocketwire Business Enterprise additionally needs the profile to have been opened at least the tier ladder's entry profile age in calendar months before the review.

**Retention.** When the volume is below the current tier's retention volume, the count of consecutive months below retention goes up by one, and the profile drops one tier only once that count exceeds the tier's grace months, the count then resetting to 0. A review at or above retention resets the count to 0 without a change.

**No other changes.** A tier is never changed between reviews or at the seller's request. A new profile's first review is on the first day of the calendar month after it opened, with the count at 0.

## Worked sequence (hypothetical tier with a retention volume of USD 2500.00 and 1 grace month)

| Review | Previous month's net sales | Count after the review | Tier change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1st review | USD 2100.00 | 1 | none (1 does not exceed 1) |
| 2nd review | USD 1900.00 | 2, then reset to 0 | drops one tier |
| (alternative 2nd review) | USD 2500.00 | 0 | none |
